scripts.//build:ask-ai: Called explicitly by every script that needs dist/, because Yarn Berry ignores arbitrary pre* hooks. TODO: assumes the Astro CI job invokes one of the build:* scripts rather than astro build directly — confirm when that job is written in DataDog/documentation-ci.
scripts.//fetch:examples: Stages the SDK code examples the API docs render. Chained into dev and build the same way build:ask-ai is, since Yarn Berry ignores arbitrary pre* hooks. No-ops when api-code-examples/ is already staged for the current branch; run `yarn fetch:examples --force` to re-fetch, or pass --pins <path> to read a local sdk_versions.json instead of the network. The dev scripts add --best-effort so an unreachable network warns instead of stopping the dev server; no build:* script does, so no build can ship API pages with missing SDK tabs.
scripts.dev: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples --best-effort && astro dev --port 4321
scripts.dev:proxied: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples --best-effort && PROXIED=1 astro dev --port 4321
scripts.build: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples && astro build
scripts.build:en: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples && SKIP_TRANSLATIONS=true astro build
scripts.build:preview: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples && CI_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=preview astro build
scripts.build:live: yarn build:ask-ai && yarn fetch:examples && CI_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=live astro build
scripts.//format: Uses astro/.prettierrc, not the repo-root prettier.config.js — Prettier picks the nearest config and uses it wholesale, so never run this from the repo root or pass the root config.
scripts.pretest: node -e "const [major] = process.versions.node.split('.').map(Number); if (major < 24) { console.error('Error: Node >=24 required (current: ' + process.version + '). Run: nvm use'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test: yarn typecheck && yarn test:headless && yarn test:browser
scripts.test-ai: yarn typecheck && yarn test:headless-ai && yarn test:browser-ai
